images.alt_en: Winter 431/0: Lysis and Mikion walk home from the Kerameikos after the public funeral; ten wagons with cypress coffins, one for each tribe, stand empty by the road.

images.original_alt_grc: ὁ Κίμων τὰ χωρία ἄφρακτα ἔχει
images.original_brief: Cimon's orchards without fences: villagers help themselves to figs and grapes while a steward watches, smiling.

images.alt_en: Morning outside the law courts in the 4th century: citizens queue at ten entrances, each holding a small bronze ticket; a stone allotment machine stands at each entrance.

images.alt_grc: ὁ ἄρχων τοὺς κύβους εἰς τὸ κληρωτήριον ἐμβάλλει
images.alt_en: The archon pours white and black balls into the bronze tube of the kleroterion; a juror whose name has been called draws an acorn-token from a water jar and holds up its letter.

images.alt_grc: ὁ δικαστὴς τὴν βακτηρίαν λαβὼν βαδίζει
